column1: # The release audit's fault-injection arms (lane verify-coverage-audit, 2026-10-21).
# tools/coverage_sabotage.py reads this file; its docstring is the contract.
# One arm per line, TAB separated: arm, patch, bindings (build script names), lanes, why.
# An arm is CAUGHT when every lane named reads MOVED or REFUSED on the build with the
# patch applied and its clean cell on the clean build of the same commit.
# 2026-10-31: multi-GPU verification retired (docs/TOMBSTONES.md MOJOLEARN_PAR_VERIFY). Eight arms named only par-*
# lanes and were dropped: coverage-core-msel_host_impl, coverage-core-shard_merge_device, coverage-ivf-index_arrays_impl,
# coverage-precise-core-shard_topk_merge_host, coverage-precise-bindings-parallel_mlp_apply; their patches stay in the tree.

column5: Every float64 output of nsum, row_means, fsum, row_stds and class_ratio is one ulp off, ragged_rows_bytes and shard_topk_merge_f32 are faulted too; GridSearchCV's mean_test_score comes from row_means_f64 and AdaBoost scales its votes by fsum_f64. trees-adaboost-reg is not named: AdaBoost.R2 predicts by the weighted median and calls none of these helpers (unmoved on Metal and the host column, 2026-10-21).

fold_ids swaps the fold ids of the first and last rows, mask_from_indices_u8 flips every mask byte, next_combination_i64 skips every other combination; cross_val_score and LassoCV folds and LeavePOut reach them.

Test-fold labels 0 and 1 swapped in assign_fold_i64 (count_fold_hits_i64 keeps the true label, so TargetEncoder's cv=<splitter> check refuses; a swap in both was a consistent relabeling no lane can see), fold labels swapped in the stratified and group fold planners, init draws one ulp off, scattered rows swapped; StratifiedKFold/GroupKFold, the MLP weight init and TargetEncoder reach them.

argmax winners stepped within range, gathers rotated by one, casts one ulp off; rf-clf/et-clf predict runs argmax_rows then decode_labels (gather_i64) on the CPU column and AutoARIMA's search gathers series rows.
transpose_to_f32 and nonzero_f64_fill write every float32 value one ulp off; ElasticNet.predict transposes through transpose_f32 and spectral-precomputed takes the COO scan on the CPU column.
narrow_w64 flips the low bit of every class item (labels 0/1 become 1/0), so Sequential's classes_, the exported file and predict move on both columns.
label_sort_key flips the low bit of every key, permuting classes and codes together; RNNClassifier's and Sequential's training targets change, so loss, params and proba move.
qn_sigmoid_device and qn_softmax_device step every float64 probability one ulp; predict_proba is hashed (GPU column).
host_grove_forest_from steps every leaf value of the resident host snapshot one ulp; both lanes set inference_engine="parallel_groves", so predict moves on the CPU column.
Every exported threshold and leaf is one ulp off, as is the transposed X; predict, proba and the model hash move on the CPU column.
Every exported threshold and leaf is one ulp off; the resident forest and the saved model are built from those arrays (device column).
Every output of the host bias/activation and ReLU backward is one ulp off; SmallMLPTrainer runs these on the CPU column, so its losses, weights and logits move.
The host gather writes every component one ulp off and swaps the first two core indices; DBSCAN.save writes both, so the model column moves (CPU column).
resample_store_indices swaps the first two indices; resample-utils hashes resample_indices' output on both columns.
Sha256.digest_words flips the low bit of all eight digest words, so every digest moves, including the payload_sha256 the saved MLP and byte-LM files carry (model column).
The device dbscan_core_gather writes every component one ulp off and swaps the first two core indices; DBSCAN.save writes both (device column).
from_f16_device steps every widened float32 word up one ulp after the device copy-back, and the lane hashes widen_f16 over all 65536 f16 patterns (GPU column).

cholesky_solve_host_run and from_f16_host_run store every output one ulp off, and these lanes hash solve() / solve_cholesky and widen_f16 through the linalg host binding. par-cholesky is not named: it reads N/A on the host column (no CPU driver), so it never loads this host binding.

gp_theta_params_values steps each float32 kernel value one ulp before widening, and log_marginal_likelihood(theta) builds the kernel from those values, so the hashed lml and gradients move (GPU column).
The same fault in gp_theta_params_list, which the host binding's gp_theta_params calls, so the CPU column's lml and grad parts move.

gbdt_host_binary_prediction_into steps the positive probability one ulp and flips every 0/1 class code, and GradientBoostingClassifier predict, predict_proba and score (via _binary_output) are hashed.

prediction_data_host_run stores every cluster death one ulp off, and the approximate_predict probabilities and membership vectors these lanes hash read the deaths. par-hdbscan is not named: it reads N/A on the host column (no CPU driver), so it never loads this host binding.
The same deaths fault in prediction_data_door_run (GPU column).
kmh_rbf_sampler_fit_into stores every weight and offset one ulp off, and the lane hashes random_weights_, random_offset_ and transform.
binary_ranking_checked returns every AUC and curve value one ulp off, and the lane hashes the unweighted binary roc_auc_score and precision_recall_curve, which call this host entry.

out_f32_to steps every word one ulp after either copy arm (GPU filter_topk distances), and out_i32_to swaps the first two words, which moves the hashed CAGRA graph on both columns; an array that starts at 0 (offsets) is left alone.

verify_digest flips the low bit of every digest and verify_fill puts every seeded float32 one ulp off; these lanes hash every part through verify_digest and tape-program fills its weights with verify_fill.
prophet_days puts every day value one float64 ulp off (order kept) and prophet_changepoints every scaled changepoint one float32 ulp off, which moves params_ and the forecasts the lane hashes.
lamb_offsets moves the first tensor boundary one value later while the flat n stays the same, so every per-tensor norm and trust ratio of the non-resident lamb_step moves.
opt_resident_move puts every state value one ulp off in both directions and lamb_resident_open fills exp_avg with 1.0, so the hashed optimizer state moves (GPU column).
onnx_read puts every float32 initializer value one ulp off in the bytes the reader keeps and every finite float attribute one float32 ulp off, so the imported program's outputs move.
ovo_dual_gemv_host puts every coef_ value one ulp off, and the lane hashes the linear multiclass coef_.

Epilogue decisions and probabilities, C rows, fold-finish decisions and Platt (A, B) one ulp off, class codes stepped within range, gathered, selected, fold and shuffle indices swapped first and last.
device_platt_train writes (A, B) one float64 ulp off and device_splitmix_perm swaps the first and last shuffle entries, so probA_, probB_ and the probabilities move (GPU column).
ovo_dual_gemv_device puts every coef_ value one ulp off after the download, and the lane hashes coef_ (GPU column).
parse_rank_table flips the low bit of every token byte (a bijection, so no duplicate-key refusal), which moves the ranks text, identity and ids of every tokenizer loaded with from_ranks_file.

Every function that writes a value is faulted (ids swapped, byte low bits flipped, every decoded sequence after the first in a batch flipped), so encode, decode, the trained vocabulary and the corpus rows move.
csr_checked_device swaps the column of the first and last edge in the CSR block spmm uses, and widen_f32_into puts every widened word one float32 ulp up (GPU column).

On the CPU column out_f32 puts every returned word one ulp up, epoch_rows_fill swaps the order's first and last rows, adam_rows puts every hyper word one ulp up, and argmax, gather and widen are faulted too.
kfeat_pcs_draw_idn steps every indexHash_ entry to (v+1) mod n_components, and kfeat_schi2_fit_idn puts every random_weights_/random_offset_ word one ulp up, the IDENTICAL draws both lanes hash.

On the host column the 1-D MinCovDet runs order_f, argmin_all, select_smallest and move, ALS recommend runs topn_desc and gather, and the qr/svd of x-decomp-lu runs r_signs and rank_above; each output is swapped, stepped or one ulp off.

The rank-deficient randomized_svd compacts Q through order_small on the host column; its first and last entries are swapped, so a live column is dropped. x-decomp-rsvd-rank-deficient is the lane whose sketch is wider than its matrix's rank (x-decomp-lstsq-rsvd never reaches the compaction: unmoved on Metal and the host column, 2026-10-21). The reduce_run hunk (a max one ulp off) feeds only NaN refusals and cutoffs, which no digest sees.
On the device column the 1-D MinCovDet's order, argmin, select and reduce, the rsvd's order_small and LLE's dsum_sq are swapped or one ulp off.
Every resident fit on the GPU binding uploads through dev_upload, reads back through dev_download and copies through dev_move, all now one ulp off.
Isomap and LLE build their graphs with graph_knn, graph_knn_dense, graph_radius, graph_lle_iw and graph_join, all one ulp off, on the host column.
The device graph builders write their edges one ulp off and dev_graph_components swaps its first two labels (GPU column).
ivf_out_of_bounds_distance returns the largest finite float32 instead of +inf, and every ivf-short-fill query pads past its candidates with it (host column).

upload, download and copy put every value one ulp off and alloc zero fill becomes the smallest normal, and sequence-device-tensor steps RMSprop over resident params and round-trips a tensor (GPU column).

column1: # lane verify-coverage-owed (2026-10-21): the arms the audit left owed to the migration lanes.

column5: rows_call swaps the two probability modes (SGDClassifier's normalized sigmoids and LogisticRegressionCV's sigmoid/softmax) and halves the Huber threshold, so outliers_ and both predict_proba tables move; the estimators bindings compile the same rows_call and call it only for ROWS_LOG and ROWS_SQRT_F32, which the fault leaves alone.

seq_optimizer_init starts the step count at 1, export_copy writes the state slots in reverse and import_copy loads the step count one ahead; the bias-corrected optimizers' steps, the exported state and the resumed steps move on both columns.

resident_open fills a fresh slot's second moment with 1, and resident_download and resident_upload swap the two moments; the Samba stack's resident AdamW step, its state_dict moments and its load_state_dict resume move on a GPU column (the host binding opens no slot: it exports no optimizer_resident_step).

count_fold_hits_i64 reports one false overlap for a nonempty index list while assign_fold_i64 stays correct; TargetEncoder rejects the valid training/test partition. This independently faults both native registrations that the previous assign-only arm left untested.

column1: # Native owner lifecycle qualification (2026-10-21): new records remain owed.

column5: lr_schedule_series zeroes its first returned rate; both array and list outputs are consumed. Mac CPU/Metal execution and restoration proven 2026-10-22; cross-vendor reference and installed-package admission pending.

Moment setters exchange first and second moments in mirrors and resident uploads; the new lane consumes both assigned moments and resumed outputs. Mac CPU/Metal execution and restoration proven 2026-10-22; NVIDIA/AMD pending.

Checkpoint load increments the saved step; the new lane consumes restored t, initialization flags, moments and continued parameters. Mac CPU/Metal execution and restoration proven 2026-10-22; NVIDIA/AMD pending.
zero_grad leaves signed zeros, nonfinite values and finite gradients unchanged; the new lane hashes every output byte. Mac CPU/Metal execution and restoration proven 2026-10-22; NVIDIA/AMD pending.

GPU and CPU IO queries report the opposite capability for a resident-disabled owner; the lane consumes query and explicit transfer-refusal outcomes. CPU scope is query/refusal, never GPU transfers. Mac CPU/Metal execution and restoration proven 2026-10-22; NVIDIA/AMD pending.

GPU parameter and gradient downloads corrupt the first value after the copy; outputs are consumed after caller buffers were overwritten. CPU N/A. Mac CPU/Metal execution and restoration proven 2026-10-22; NVIDIA/AMD pending.

Free leaves the allocation open; the lane independently probes the pool after explicit, repeated, GC and forced upload/copy failure cleanup. CPU N/A. Mac CPU/Metal execution and restoration proven 2026-10-22; NVIDIA/AMD pending.

column1: # lane verify-gaps-20261022: the arms the 2026-10-22 audit read owed (docs/plans/VERIFY_COVERAGE_20261022.md).

column5: Every float16 checkpoint tensor widened one float32 ulp off in checkpoint_widen_halves; both lanes read an F16 tensor through SafetensorsFile/Checkpoint.read and hash its bytes (hf-checkpoint `dtypes`, hf-model-surface `shards`).

json_digits_end ends every run of three or more digits one digit early; every safetensors header (data_offsets) and config.json (max_position_embeddings, rope_theta) the lanes open is parsed by the native JSON reader, which then refuses the document.

sequence_narrow_halves stores every half one ulp off; the lane fits LinearRegression, Ridge, the scalers and PCA on a list of float16 rows (the promoted half matrix) and holds the linear fits to the float16 ndarray's.

scaler_cast writes the first cast value one unit high; StandardScaler.fit on the lane's list of float16 rows casts the half matrix to float32 through it, and the lane holds the statistics to the float32 ndarray's.
mlp_read_f32 reads every training loss back one unit high; the lane hashes the three SmallMLPTrainer.train_step losses (`loss`).

pca_check_state doubles the first validated singular_values_ word; the live whitened PCA transform consumes it and the lane hashes that result as wT. The former pca_widen_spectrum patch targeted an uncalled helper and MISSED on source243; that original failure remains retained.

registry_offsets moves every interior tensor boundary of the optimizer registry one float early, so a parameter's last value and the next parameter's first share a slot; each lane steps several parameter tensors and hashes them.

host_slot negates the slot's first moment on every lookup; on the host column SGD with momentum steps through the host resident slot (public_step_host), so the momentum buffer and the parameters move.

causal_lm_gather_f32 negates and shifts the first gathered value; the lane builds CausalLM(plan, weights) with a column-major head, which the model gathers into C order, and hashes its logits (`gathered`).

minmax_fit_transform_direct reads the fitted min_ row as the scale, so MinMaxScaler.fit_transform's words move on the GPU column while fit then transform does not; scaler-fit-transform hashes both and their agreement.
_accumulate_out adds one to the first accumulated float on the host-pointer path every training.accumulate_grads call takes; grad-accumulation hashes the combined gradient.
_device_logit shifts token 0's logit by 1/16 in the device rows, loss and gradient kernels; training-chunked-lm-head hashes the loss and both gradients.
_perm_gather_kernel doubles the first gathered value and _perm_inverse_kernel swaps the first two inverse positions in the device CSR views; x-cnn-gcn (edge-weighted GCN) hashes forward and backward.
perm_gather_host and vals_t_host double their first output value on the host column's CSR views; x-cnn-gcn (edge-weighted GCN forward and backward through the transposed weighted view) hashes them.

every scalar score the GPU metrics binding's host doors return (accuracy, rand, adjusted rand, entropy, mutual information, homogeneity, completeness, V-measure, Fowlkes-Mallows, R^2, KL, MSE/MAE/RMSE, log loss) moves by 1/128; the metrics lanes hash each score.

the GPU preprocessing binding's direct fits double the first scale_ word (minmax_fit_direct, standard_fit_direct) and its direct transforms move the first output word (minmax/standard transform, standard fit_transform); the scaler lanes hash scale_ and the transforms.

the linear fits' column sums (one ulp), centered and row-scaled cells, float32 means and intercept, and the OLS and multi-target ridge predictions move on the GPU binding and its host twin; the OLS, weighted OLS, ridge and multi-output ridge lanes hash coefficients, intercepts and predictions.

the GPU linalg binding's bf16 widen and narrow kernels move their first word, the int8 row quantizer steps the first row exponent and the dequantizer doubles its first value; the low-bit lanes hash packed and materialized weights and the low-bit GEMM outputs.

consistent wrong answers, never memory faults: the snapshot gather swaps its first two rows, the group split moves one test group to train (sums computed with it), the shuffled GroupKFold moves every group to the next fold with the sizes rotated, the probability column moves its first value; on the GPU base binding and the core host binding. The first patch left tables and sums disagreeing and crashed both columns (exit 134) on 9b04b92c5.
residual_dropout's forward and backward move their first output word on the GPU binding and the host twin; public-residual-dropout hashes both directions.

on the GPU CNN binding the element-wise map (add, multiply, ReLU and its backward into host memory), the BatchNorm forward and backward outputs and a resident download move their first value by 1/128, and the resident argmax moves the first label to the next class; the BatchNorm, SAGE and CNNClassifier.predict lanes hash those outputs.

on the x_neighbors host column the component relabel moves the first label and the one-class sign labeling negates the first label; the connected-components and one-class SVM lanes hash them (the row softmax edit was dropped: xn_softmax64 exists only in fast builds, NC_PROBA64).

the host column's dense-to-COO fill doubles its first stored nonzero and the host kNN affinity writes 0.25 at (0, 1); x-cluster-spectral-affinities hashes the embeddings and labels built on those graphs (MOVED on the host column on 9b04b92c5). A GPU install never reaches the base binding's COO scan: the metrics dense entry serves every affinity.
the host column's PolynomialCountSketch draw negates its first sign and SkewedChi2Sampler doubles its first weight; the two lanes hash the fitted maps and transforms.

gamma='scale''s exact variance sums take a wrong cell (cell 0 replaced by cell 1 on the device grid, counted twice on the host); svc-gamma-scale reaches them through SVC.fit / SVR.fit -> bindings/svc_kernel_native.mojo _resolve_gamma -> the svm binding's scale_gamma_limbs. The svc lane uses the package default gamma='auto' and never takes this path (MISSED twice, 9b04b92c5 and the re-proof).
the GPU gbdt binding's binary prediction flips its first label or probability (1 - v); gbdt-adapter-clf hashes predict and predict_proba.
RidgeCV's k-fold best-alpha choice takes the next alpha; x-ridge-cv-kfold hashes alpha_, the refit and its predictions.

the training binding's MLP host doors (bias+activation, ReLU backward, row sums, through _mlp_host) move their first output by 1/128; neural-trainer-unfused runs the unfused per-layer gradient route (MOJOLEARN_MLP_FUSED=0, the route a multi-device optimizer takes) that calls them.
the neural RNG's first draw moves by 1/128; the Samba dropout lane hashes the trained state (MOVED on Metal on 9b04b92c5 under the combined arm).

column1: # lane native-neighbors-20261024: the k-NN one-call doors (bindings/neighbors_knn_native.mojo).

column5: _dist_params swaps the uniform and distance weight codes the k-NN classify/regress doors hand the search: every vote and mean is reweighted

ops_imported_run (ImportedProgram.run) puts the first value of every output one float32 ulp off when it packs the declared-shape output arrays; sequence-onnx-import hashes both runs of the imported ONNX model on both columns.

The native parameter glue keeps only the first keyword: the linear constructor drops every later keyword to its default (HuberRegressor(epsilon=..., max_iter=..., alpha=...) keeps epsilon only), the linear set_params and the declared prep/decomp set_params drop every later assignment (include_bias, epsilon, random_state); public-set-params digests the refit outputs and the parameters read back, x-huber-outliers its outliers_ at max_iter=30 (lane coverage-gap-lanes-20261025).

column1: # lane precise-coverage-0859 (2026-10-26): arms for the registrations made precise and the precise rows no arm
# named lanes for. Arms marked REFUSED-only in their why read REFUSED, not MOVED: their check needs the hash-bound
# review (--evidence) naming the product check reached. Unproven until tools/coverage_sabotage_batch.sh runs them.

column5: The block RMSNorm's output (mamba_rms_out_kernel, the IDENTICAL tree route, and mamba_rms_norm_kernel) has its low bit flipped, and every Mamba-1/2/3 session step and per-call step runs that norm first (mamba_step/mamba2_block_forward/mamba3_block_forward -> mamba_rms_norm), so the session outputs and synced states move while the in-cell session==per-call oracle still agrees.

_m3_load_weights loads C_norm.weight from B_norm.weight's address; mamba3_session_open and the per-call mamba3_decode_step (_mamba3_run) both load weights through it and the lane's near_one norms differ, so steps and states move identically on both sides of the in-cell oracle.

_m3_session_export_run writes buffer_qrot and buffer_krot swapped; the lane's sync_state reads them through mamba3_session_export_state, and its in-cell byte oracle against the per-call state refuses by name (REFUSED: needs a hash-bound oracle review in --evidence, since no shared path exists to move both sides).

_m3_session_copy_in loads buffer_qrot and buffer_krot swapped (a no-op on the zero state at open, live on the synced four-token state at load_state); the steps after mamba3_session_load_state then differ from the per-call steps and the lane's in-cell oracle refuses by name (REFUSED: needs a hash-bound oracle review in --evidence).

_rf_classifier_fit/_rf_regressor_fit write forest.oob_score_ + 1e-9 into the requested score buffer, which only the aux entries (rf_*_fit_aux_export) pass; the lane's RF fits with oob_score=True digest oob_score_ (rf_oob, rfr_oob).

Reused: every threshold and leaf rf_export_trees_into copies out is one ulp off; the lanes' float64 Fortran-order fits take rf_classifier_fit_export/rf_regressor_fit_export and their colmajor parts predict from the exported arrays.

Reused: rf_export_trees_into's thresholds and leaves are one ulp off; class_weight/sample_weight fits (rf_classifier_fit_weighted_export, rf_regressor_fit_weighted_export, AdaBoost's weighted members) export through it and the lanes digest their predict_proba/predict.

pca_fit_host (the body of the pca_fit export and of the PCA owner's covariance arm, pca_fit_owned) publishes every explained_variance_ word scaled by 1 + 1e-6; PCA(n_components=4) with svd_solver 'auto' takes that arm on the device column and both lanes hash explained_variance_.

cross_vendor_fold (cross_vendor_call 'fold' and 'pair') leaves every added shard's last element out of the fold, consistently for the whole and resumed folds, so the lane's fold, prefix and pair digests move.

vocab_fingerprint_hex hashes one extra byte, so every vocabulary fingerprint moves (checkpoint and resume use the same faulted function and still agree); the lane hashes the checkpoint's tokenizer fingerprint.

mle_pick (the last phase of x_decomp_dev_pca_mle_rank / x_decomp_pca_mle_rank, and of the PCA owner's pca_mle_rank_device kernel) returns a neighboring valid rank; PCA(n_components='mle') on the device column keeps a different count and the lane hashes n_components_, components_ and noise_variance_.

The same mle_pick step on the host column: pca_mle_rank_host (x_decomp_pca_mle_rank's body, and estimators_host's pca_mle_rank_host_run) returns a neighboring valid rank, so PCA(n_components='mle') keeps a different count and the mle part moves.

log_softmax_kernel (xn_log_softmax) moves each row's first log-probability by 1e-6 relative plus 1e-6 absolute; NearestCentroid.predict_log_proba runs it on the device column and the lane hashes log_proba.

MselHostStore.put keeps its copy with the first byte's low bit flipped, so the resident fold snapshots model_selection._Resident puts through arena_msel_put (X, y and the int64 fold indices take_rows gathers by) change and x-metrics-search's cross_validate, cross_val_predict and GridSearchCV hashes move on the CPU column.

MselHostStore.read flips the low bit of the first downloaded byte, and msel_read is how cross_val_predict (bindings/msel_cv.mojo) downloads the scattered float64 prediction block, so x-metrics-search's `predict` part moves on the CPU column.

ovo_layout_host writes every one-vs-one dual coefficient scaled by 1 + 1e-6, and the four-class SVC fit lays out dual_coef_ through svc_ovo_layout (bindings/svc_kernel_native.mojo _fit_ovo), so x-neighbors-svc-multiclass's dual, ovo and ovr_dual hashes move on the CPU column.

ranks_text renders the rank ids swapped pairwise, so BpeTokenizer.identity (the sha256 of bpe_ranks_text, taken by v.tokenizer() and from_ranks_file) no longer equals the trained vocabulary's identity and bpe-vocabulary's flags move.

csr_build_host permutes the CSR column array of both _Graph views (bindings/xcnn_graph_native.mojo _csr), so every GCN and SAGE aggregation gathers other neighbors and those lanes' outputs move on the CPU column.

first_rows_i32 (host code in both x_metrics bindings) mirrors the first-seen rows, so msel_first_seen reverses StratifiedKFold's first-seen class order and the skf, skf_shuffle and rskf folds x-metrics-splitters hashes move on the device and CPU columns.

nan_cells_host steps each missing cell's flat index to a neighboring cell, so KNNImputer.transform (bindings/neighbors_local_native.mojo) imputes present cells and leaves the NaNs, and x-neighbors-knn-imputer's u, w and mv hashes move on the CPU column.

op_row_all_zero reports row 0 all-zero, so the cosine AgglomerativeClustering fit in x-cluster-agglo-linkages REFUSES at the product check 'Cosine affinity cannot be used when X contains zero vectors' (bindings/cfb_agglo.mojo); the flag has no other lane-reached reader, so this arm is caught by REFUSED with that check named.

op_row_argmax moves row 0's argmax to the next column, and LabelPropagation/LabelSpreading set transduction_ and predict through row_argmax (bindings/neighbors_semi_native.mojo _semi_argmax_labels), so both lanes' tr hashes move on the CPU column.
spearman_sign_host returns the negated sign of Spearman's rho, flipping IsotonicRegression(increasing='auto')'s direction (the lane gained the call in lane precise-coverage-0859)

op_p2m_const_cols inverts the every-column-constant flag NearestCentroid's fit reads only when every within-class std is zero (the lane gained the call in lane precise-coverage-0859); with the lane's distinct class rows the inverted flag makes the fit raise 'All features have zero variance', so the lane reads REFUSED (needs the hash-bound review)
op_p2m_transpose_i steps the first transposed label, which KNeighborsClassifier.fit runs only for a 2-D (multi-output) y (the lane gained the call in lane precise-coverage-0859)
